notes: Batch L (6 medicines). amlodipine-valsartan-hydrochlorothiazide = no-uk-product (no emc or MHRA products SPC/PIL for the triple combination). perindopril-amlodipine uses UK perindopril tert-butylamine/amlodipine SmPCs because no UK perindopril arginine/amlodipine SmPC exists (emc and MHRA products searched). captopril tablets: no tablet SmPC on emc; MHRA products tablet SPCs used. New condition extracorporeal-blood-treatment is shared by perindopril, perindopril-amlodipine and captopril. Group diuretic now has sourced members from batches B, K, L and M (spironolactone, furosemide, indapamide, hydrochlorothiazide, co-amilozide, atenolol/chlortalidone and the thiazide combinations). Per-medicine notes follow. || captopril: captopril: no captopril TABLET SmPC on emc (only oral solutions); tablet SPCs taken from MHRA products (Tillomed 25 mg and 50 mg; a second UK holder's tablet SPCs have essentially the same text). Both tablet SPCs list 'Lactation' in section 4.3 while their own section 4.6 (and MHRA DSU 2009) allow use with an older infant if needed: kept as two separate breastfeeding rules (contraindicated per 4.3; avoid in first weeks/preterm per 4.6+MHRA). The SPC section 4.4 also says 'Patients with renal impairment should not normally be treated with captopril' despite giving a renal dosing table; recorded as an avoid condition rule (audit: "should not normally" = avoid, "normally" kept in the text) plus CrCl dose bands (21-40, 10-20, <10 mL/min/1.73 m2). SPS has no captopril-specific breastfeeding entry (general ACE inhibitor advice only). amlodipine-valsartan-hydrochlorothiazide: marked no-uk-product (no emc or MHRA products SPC/PIL for the triple combination). || perindopril: perindopril: built from emc-10545 (perindopril arginine 2.5/5/10 mg; emc last updated 04 Nov 2021, text revision 10/2021). The MHRA products 5 mg SPC (https://mhraproducts4853.blob.core.windows.net/docs/1ed4302f20d9eac5fe7fd6506e29ff19d7d06382, indexed 2026-06-19) states date of revision 11/06/2021 and its sections 4.1-4.9 matched the emc text, so it was not used. Condition primary-hyperaldosteronism reuses batch K's id. Renal table uses strict bounds (30 < CrCl < 60, 15 < CrCl < 30, CrCl < 15 on haemodialysis); rules use min 30/max 60, min 15/max 30, max 15, so CrCl exactly 30 or 15 falls in the milder band; SmPC gives no dose for CrCl < 15 without dialysis. NSAIDs have two rules: hyperkalaemia list (not recommended, avoid) and NSAID paragraph (caution, renal). Aspirin anti-inflammatory-dose interaction (>= 3 g/day) is text only (audit: the rule was removed because every master aspirin formulation is 75 mg). Text only (not in master list): aliskiren, sacubitril/valsartan, heparins, ciclosporin, tacrolimus, mTOR inhibitors, lithium, baclofen, estramustine, injectable gold, antipsychotics, anaesthetics. The diuretic first-dose hypotension rule uses group:diuretic because SmPC 4.2 speaks of diuretics in general. No brand-prescribing statement found. || perindopril-amlodipine: perindopril-amlodipine: no perindopril ARGININE/amlodipine product found on emc or MHRA products (clinic product is the arginine salt). Content uses the UK perindopril TERT-BUTYLAMINE/amlodipine SmPCs (emc-15441/15443/15444/15445, same holder, identical clinical text; quotes cited from emc-15441). Salt note sourced: 4 mg tert-butylamine = 3.34 mg perindopril; arginine 5 mg = 3.395 mg perindopril (emc-10545); combination SmPC states 8 mg tert-butylamine is equivalent to 10 mg arginine. emc-15441 is dated 25 Jan 2024. Aliskiren and sacubitril/valsartan contraindications are listed in sections but not engine rules (not in master list). Aspirin (>=3 g/day) interaction is text only (audit: rule removed, all master aspirin is 75 mg). Diuretic rules use group:thiazide + group:loop-diuretic (source heading "Non-potassium-sparing diuretics"). All 235 quotes checked FOUND against cached page text. Shared source objects copied verbatim from batch B (same ids and URLs). || amlodipine-valsartan: amlodipine-valsartan: emc-7769 is one combined SmPC for 5/80, 5/160 and 10/160 (emc 7771 and 306 show the same text; MHRA products also lists the GB SPCs). The 4.3 aliskiren contraindication (diabetes or GFR <60) cannot be an engine rule because aliskiren is not in the master list; it is kept in contraindications/renal text. Lithium, tacrolimus, dantrolene, heparin, rifampicin, ciclosporin, ritonavir interactions are not in the master list (text only; dantrolene expressed as the malignant-hyperthermia condition rule). Potassium-sparing diuretics/potassium supplements set to avoid because the SmPC lists them under the valsartan heading "Concomitant use not recommended" while 4.4 says caution with frequent monitoring. Renal: the SmPC gives no number for moderate impairment, so the moderate-impairment monitoring advice is a renal-impairment condition rule (audit removed the inferred GFR 60 bound); GFR <=30 is outside the stated no-adjustment range (info). Severe renal impairment (GFR <=30) recorded as info (no clinical data). Clinic strengths (160 mg valsartan) exceed the 80 mg valsartan maximum in mild-moderate hepatic impairment. BUMPS ARB page uses batch K id bumps-arbs (audit harmonised). Groups not added: amlodipine is called a CYP3A4 inhibitor in the MHRA simvastatin DSU, but amlodipine-valsartan was not added to cyp3a4-inhibitor to stay consistent with amlodipine.json. || lisinopril-hydrochlorothiazide: lisinopril-hydrochlorothiazide: emc-5501 and emc-5502 SmPC sections 4.1-4.8 are identical apart from punctuation; quotes cite emc-5502. Paediatric: SmPC only says safety/efficacy not established, so the age rule is level info. NSAID interaction: this SmPC states the effects but no action, so level info (the lisinopril-alone SmPC says administer with caution). SPS breastfeeding page covers lisinopril only; no SPS breastfeeding page for thiazides found. Sulfonamide allergy: SmPC 4.3 contraindication kept as its own rule; SPS cross-reactivity advice kept as 3 separate rules (serious antibiotic reaction = caution; minor antibiotic reaction = info; different non-antibiotic class = info). Aspirin (>3 g/day) rule removed (all master aspirin is 75 mg). Not mapped (not in master list): lithium, aliskiren, sacubitril/valsartan, digoxin, sotalol, colestyramine/colestipol, ciclosporin, heparin, lovastatin, amantadine, injectable gold, antipsychotics, mTOR inhibitors. Condition ids reused from batches A/B/E/K/M: acute-renal-insufficiency-anuria, severe-renal-impairment, angioedema-history-other, recent-kidney-transplant, mitral-stenosis, skin-cancer-history (batch K id; audit harmonised), hydrochlorothiazide-ards-history, gout-hyperuricaemia, hypomagnesaemia. || AUDIT 2026-10-17 (second check, log audit/L-M.md): group non-antibiotic-sulfonamide extended with SPS-listed sulfonamide-group drugs celecoxib, rosuvastatin, tamsulosin, valsartan-hydrochlorothiazide and telmisartan-hydrochlorothiazide (gliclazide/glimepiride already added by batch H). MHRA HCTZ skin-cancer DSU now uses batch K id mhra-dsu-hctz-nmsc-2018.
